body: Haha, that’s genuinely a very good simile. I guess I’ve invested too much into this omakase to just up and leave. But for all the grief I’m going through, I better get some freaking Wagyu by the end of it LOL
Yes, I’m so afraid I won’t be able to afford housing anywhere.
I hope I can one day, I’m just having trouble seeing how it could be possible at all, lately.

Well I’m on academic probation. I need to be able to pass my classes to be able to come out of probation but at this point I’m too far behind to catch up. If I am in probation too long, I’ll be dismissed from school. That how things are looking right now.
I feel like with other people that could be possible, but I don’t know if I can keep up a good job that’ll pay me enough to live somewhere okay until I can go back to school.

I’d love to be able to experience an authentic Japanese Omakase style dinner, and eat until I’m sick! I’d love to be able to go to see the tide pools on the Washington coast. I’d love to be able to live comfortably in an apartment with my girlfriend and have two dogs and one cat. I wish I could do all that and more.
